page.content:
NASA's long campaign of orbiters, landers, and rovers at Mars.

How Mars Exploration Program connects

  • Vehicle: Curiosity — Curiosity is the Mars Science Laboratory rover of the Mars program.
  • Item: Perseverance — Perseverance is the Mars 2020 rover of the Mars Exploration Program.
  • Topic: NASA — The Mars Exploration Program is NASA's long robotic campaign at Mars.
  • Faction: Jet Propulsion Laboratory — JPL runs NASA's Mars rover and orbiter campaign.

What is Mars Exploration Program?

The Mars Exploration Program at JPL sequenced Pathfinder, the MER rovers, Curiosity, InSight, and Perseverance as a continuous robotic presence on and around Mars.

Key threads lead to Curiosity, Perseverance, NASA and Jet Propulsion Laboratory.
